Title: Verify cannot delete current logged in user
Preconditions: User is logged in as Admin
Test Data: User ID of logged in user
Steps: 1. Send DELETE request to /api/v2/admin/users with current user ID.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Current user is not deleted.

Title: Verify cannot delete default admin user
Steps: 1. Send DELETE request to /api/v2/admin/users with default admin ID.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Default admin is not deleted.

Title: Verify create user fails with existing username
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create user with existing username.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with unique validation error.

Title: Verify create user succeeds with valid data
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create user with valid data.

Title: Verify username length validation (min 5)
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create user with username length < 5.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with length validation error.

Title: Verify Job Specification can be replaced
Preconditions: Job Title has an existing spec
Steps: 1. Send PUT request to edit Job Title with replace flag and new file.

Title: Verify Job Specification can be deleted
Preconditions: Job Title has an existing spec
Steps: 1. Send PUT request to edit Job Title with delete flag.

Title: Verify cannot delete root subunit
Steps: 1. Send DELETE request to delete subunit id=1.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Root node cannot be deleted.

Title: Verify Pay Grade max salary > min salary
Steps: 1. Send POST request to add Pay Grade currency with max < min.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Validation error "Min salary should be less than max salary" is shown.

Title: Verify create Job Title fails with existing title
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create Job Title with existing title.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with unique validation error.
